submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce one opaque full-bleed native1254-square game-map detail for r09_c08/r02_c02. Image1 gives exact framing, scale and existing object footprints. The TOP115 rows and RIGHTMOST115 columns are native neighbor references: preserve existing contours, grooves, materials and shadow endpoints at their exact coordinates; north wins the shared top-right corner. Rows115..229 and columns1024..1138 contain guide-only soft transitions into regional context. Rebuild those into continuous painting; never copy guide bounds as walls, steps, dark bars, abrupt texture changes or truncated grooves. Reconstruct the soft interior as crisp native detail. Image2 is the user-approved primary painting/material style: bright, clean, rounded, full-bodied Daoist chibi fantasy with smooth readable bevels and restrained low-contrast surfaces. Copy no UI, text, symbols, floral ornaments, characters, lighting or objects from Image2. Keep ONLY objects and materials already present in Image1; no additions, recropping, repositioning, rotation or enlargement. Quiet ivory stone: no grit, cracks, veins, stains, bright scored scratches, harsh brush patches, blur or sharpening halos. Rounded clean existing leaves. No new buildings, stairs, medallions, frames, labels or watermark. Return only this single native detail image.
Actually viewed inventory: most of Image1 is quiet warm ivory paving. Across the TOP crop is one partly cropped square ivory stone block/pillar at x280..675, with its existing soft gray shadow toward the upper-left; a broad circular ivory planter curb with existing green leaves continues from the block across the top-right. Preserve block corner, all curb contours, rounded bevels and existing shadow footprint. One and ONLY ONE broad shallow brown paving joint slopes gently from left near y110 to right near y465. Match both its ends, bevel and tangent to the sharp native neighbor strips. Existing soft pink rounded blossom/leaf clusters are cropped along the LEFT and LOWER-LEFT boundaries, growing to about x320 near the bottom; keep their existing silhouette and distribution, refine only their clean rounded volumes. Two tiny existing pink tips enter at the left around y500. Add no new foliage outside these existing footprints, no trunk or new object. Integrate the apparent vertical light change in the top-right planter at x1139 and the horizontal soft guide strip into continuous same-material painting; no straight editing boundary may remain. No extra joints, radial planter cuts, cracks, small scratches, speckles, hard grid or decorations. Preserve framing and scale exactly.
